summary: Vail Mountain Rescue Group dispatched team members to carry out an injured hiker in the Missouri Lakes backcountry; the hiker was evacuated to an ambulance and all team members were out of the field by 8:30 p.m.
notes: Vail Daily feed (Edward Stoner) via Vail Chamber Jul/Aug 2015 mission roundup; VMRG dispatched 6 p.m. July 4; injury mechanism unreported in source
